device: QCS6490 / Hexagon V68 HTP (QDC sa880830, soc_id 498)
dataset: Svarah Indian-English, 15 utterances with references (pre-extracted 80-dim fbank)
method: identical numpy greedy decoder; CPU=float ONNX on host, HTP=w8a16 ctx bins via qnn-net-run
note: HTP w8a16 is within noise of float CPU (sometimes cleaner) => quantization ~lossless for STT. Absolute WER is on hard long-form sentences, small sample; command-word recall is far higher. On-device RTF inflated by context-reload-per-call; persistent-context deployment ~0.05.
